notes: Importing your history on a local model is dramatically better. Your kit now listens while the model writes instead of giving up after ninety seconds, keeps the model warm between calls, and asks for tighter summaries, so each conversation takes about half the time and none of them fail for being slow.

You can now watch your kit dream. While it is importing or dreaming, click the status line in the menu bar and the dreaming screen opens: which conversation it is reading, the memories forming word by word, and how long is left.
The import progress line now shows real pace, measured on your machine, not a guess.
